environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on Windows Server 2022 IIS with Active Directory integration. The SQL Server connection string uses a service account 'svc_corpdirectory' with db_owner role on the AuditDb database. LDAP path points to DC=corp,DC=internal. No input sanitization middleware. Application runs in Kestrel behind IIS with default configuration. No WAF or API gateway in front of the service.

config.network: direct exposure on internal network, no WAF
config.iis_config: default reverse proxy, no request filtering rules
